_doc: The chercheur's continuous mind (owner 2026-10-02). It reads this FIRST
every night and writes it LAST. Nothing here is overwritten by the app;
only the chercheur edits it. Members never see this file directly - the
night report's beliefs are the top of `hypotheses`, in plain words.
hypotheses: what it believes, with a status (nouveau / en test / renforce /
affaibli / rejete / dans le robot), the evidence trail (one line per night
it moved), and what would settle it next.
tried: every what-if it ran or proposed, the result, so it never repeats
scrutiny_log: which facts/piles it examined on which night, and what it saw.
lessons: things it learned about the data itself (traps, noise floors).
open: questions it has not answered yet, ranked.

hypotheses.fr: Marché très endormi (allure sous 0,8) : le robot y perd plus qu'ailleurs.
evidence: 2026-10-02 veille: 6 trades, 33% gagnés vs 58% ailleurs, net -18.85 $, PF 0.17; moitiés 0% (1) / 40% (5); 2 des 3 nouveaux trades sous 0,8 perdus, vers minuit
hypotheses.next: Attendre au moins 15 trades sous 0,8 ; vérifier que ce n'est pas l'heure (00 h aussi négative, 6 trades -12 $) qui parle à sa place.

hypotheses.fr: Le robot va beaucoup mieux depuis la mi-période (33% puis 74% de gains) : changement de marché ou de réglage ?
evidence: 2026-10-02 veille: 37 trades, moitié 1 33% (18), moitié 2 74% (19); 10 des 12 derniers gagnés (+45 $)
hypotheses.next: Tout filtre jugé sur les deux moitiés doit en tenir compte : un filtre qui ne gagne que sur la moitié 1 peut juste couper la mauvaise période.

scrutiny_log.saw: 10/12 recent wins (+45 $). nerv<0.8: 6 tr 33% -18.85 (peu). After 2 losses in a row: 0/3. Longest loss streak 6. Five proposals already pending -> no new proposal, no harness run, no new pile.

lessons: 2026-10-02: the two halves differ hugely (33% vs 74% win) - almost every bucket shows agree=false for that reason alone; read a bucket's halves against the overall halves, not against each other.
open: Is the midnight weakness (00 h: 6 tr, -12 $) the same thing as the sleepy-market weakness? Cross hour x nerv when n allows.
